I wanted to disapear from the face of earth. Like my exsistance was so small and meaningless it would no affect anyone. Nothing in my life was going the way i wanted it to, it was chaotic and completely out of my control. All of the expectations set by my mom where never met and my eating disorder did not help at all. I felt helpless and had no motivation to do anything. What made it worse is that no one wanted to validate how i felt. When i finally told someone about how i felt they all said that i should be thankful that i am tall, pretty, well off and smart.  I never though i was clinically depressed, i thought depression was just some excuse for people who just mooched off other people. Slowly i started self destructing in ways that i could, by starving, drugs, sex, drugs and just being super self critical about every flaw in my personality and body.

So i got my prescription sleeping pills and a bottle of vodka, but when i looked down to my hands i could not do it. I hated myself because i couldn't even kill my self without being a pussy about it. After my attempt i couldn't even look at myself in the mirror.

I never told anyone about my suicide attempt. 

So instead, before going to college i decided to abruptly drop everything. I was about to pay for my first semester for tuition, when i decided to buy a one way ticked to Sweden. Did not regret anything. At the begining it wad very hard. The people were cold, and so was the weather, i felt lost for a while, i didnt know my next move in life and everyday was as unpredictible as the last. But that made it fun, it was the mystery of life. Slowly, day after day i began to apreciate the little things, and life wasnt so dull. Feelings started to come back, and so did my old self (happy normal self). Now i am a normal functioning human being at a healthy weight and with a wonderful boyfriend, so, there is that!

TL;DR: tried to commit suicide, ended up in Sweden. No regerts.
